original_method: Record platform/device/fio identity and health; preserve logs; designate disposable non-OS storage and authorize overwrite; correct randread to bounded randrw/rwmixread=30 with explicit target/size; validate topology; execute once; collect fio/device evidence; leave recovery to owner.
manual_activity: Storage/data owner designates disposable target, authorizes 70% write workload and approves corrected profile, runtime, spec and recovery; agent may execute afterward.

Explicit empty/unmounted/non-OS/non-production confirmation and data-loss authorization

Versioned read/write performance thresholds and tolerance
SMART/media/thermal/power abort, cleanup, remount/reinitialization and invalid-run policy

Stop on target mismatch, mount change, media/SMART error, thermal/power limit or instability

Run only exact approved bounded job

review_improvement: Corrects the read-only/write-heavy contradiction and requires explicit ownership of the destructive target and execution envelope.
independent_technical_reasoning: A 70%-write mix requires randrw with `rwmixread=30`; randread exercises no write path and cannot represent controller garbage collection, write amplification or write latency.
